modelListManualHint: You can enter a model id by hand
toolSectionNote: Tools follow the permission mode: reads run at once, writes ask according to the mode. Note what deletion does: a diary goes to the recycle bin, a saved fact is gone for good.
notesLede: Notes the assistant reads in every conversation: how to address you, preferences, things to avoid.
memoryTileSubtitle: When on, the assistant keeps what you tell it, on this device only
memoryLede: What the assistant saved about you. It lives only on this device, and never leaves in a sync or an export.
memoryDeleteMessage: “{text}” is deleted for good and the assistant will not recall it again.
memoryClearMessage: Everything the assistant saved is deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
memoryEmptyDes: Say “remember that…” in a chat, or tell the assistant about a habit, and it saves it.
toolSearchDes: Find your local diaries by keyword or by meaning, or browse them by date and category. The meaning path needs the local semantic index enabled in settings.
toolGetDes: Read the full text of diaries by id, several at a time.
toolOverviewDes: Counts your diaries in total and per category, and their date span.
toolCreateDes: Saves content as a new local diary entry when you ask.
toolUpdateDes: Change the title, body, mood or category of diaries, several at a time.
toolDeleteDes: Move diaries to the recycle bin, where you can restore them.
toolListCategoriesDes: Lists all of your diary categories.
toolDeleteCategoryDes: Delete categories, only while they hold no diaries.
toolRecallMemoryDes: Look up saved long-term facts about you when they are needed.
toolRememberDes: Save durable facts about you — lasting preferences, recurring themes, ongoing goals — so they can be recalled in later chats.
toolJsDes: Run a short piece of JavaScript in isolation to compute something. No network, no access to your diaries.
compactionNotice: Earlier messages summarized to save context
compactionSheetNote: To save context, earlier messages are folded into the summary below before being sent to the model. The full messages are kept in this conversation and you can still scroll back to them.
disclaimerContent:
The Moodiary assistant is powered by third-party large language models. Please be aware:

• AI-generated content may be inaccurate, incomplete, or even misleading. Do not rely on it as professional (medical, psychological, legal, or financial) advice, or as the basis for any important decision.

• When you send a message, your input is sent to the model provider you configured. When the assistant uses the diary tools, relevant local diary excerpts are sent as well in order to generate a reply. It is up to you to decide whether to trust that provider.

• Your API key is stored only in local secure storage and is never uploaded to Moodiary's servers.

By continuing, you acknowledge and accept the risks above.
disclaimerGateTitle: Accept the disclaimer to use the assistant
